subject: SIG - access controls runbook request and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Jake Morris <j.morris@bluewavehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: security@bluewavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG access controls: primary artifacts and quick runbook ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Bluewave's procurement team is moving fast and our InfoSec reviewer asked for the SIG access controls section (SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA/least-privilege). Rather than the full questionnaire immediately, could you send: 1) a short runbook that lists the artifacts we should expect to receive for that section; and 2) a prioritized checklist with owners and estimated delivery times?

Specifically we need evidence of: single sign-on (SAML metadata + SSO logs), SCIM provisioning sample mapping (CSV), RBAC role-to-permission matrix, MFA enforcement policy and any exception process, and a short note on least-privilege design decisions. If you already have a canonical list or a template you use for customers, that would be ideal.

I attached the SIG section spreadsheet Bluewave will use for mapping answers. Happy to narrate the timeline once I see what you can provide.

Best,
Jake
Security Operations
Bluewave Health

Attachments: sig_access_questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet listing required fields)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Jake Morris <j.morris@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG access controls: primary artifacts and quick runbook ask

Jake —

Thanks for the clear ask. We have an internal "access controls runbook" we can use as the base and will tailor the artifact list to the Bluewave spreadsheet. High-level plan below:

1) Deliver a concise runbook (one-pager) describing each artifact + source (who generates it) — target: 2 business days.
2) Provide sample artifacts: SAML metadata + TLS cert thumbprint, last 30 days of SSO auth logs (redacted PII), sample SCIM mapping CSV, RBAC matrix PDF, MFA policy excerpt and exception workflow doc — target: 4 business days.
3) Assign owners and ETA in the runbook; add one optional canary deliverable (test SCIM sync with a sample MS Azure tenant) if you want an on-demand proof — need 7 business days for that.

I've looped in Marissa (Customer Security) for artifact pulls and Rishi (Identity infra) for any live log exports and SCIM samples. If you want the runbook faster we can trim the artifact set and iterate.

Action items:
- Jake: confirm which artifacts are mandatory vs nice-to-have in your mapping (reply to this thread).
- Marissa: can you pick lead on SSO logs + RBAC matrix extraction?
- Rishi: please confirm feasibility of sharing a 30-day auth log extract and a sample SCIM mapping CSV.

Thanks — will follow up with a one-pager and a delivery timeline.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Jake Morris <j.morris@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG access controls: primary artifacts and quick runbook ask

Jake — quick note on what we can realistically hand over without additional approvals:

- SAML metadata: full metadata XML and certificate fingerprint — ready.
- SSO logs: we can provide a 30-day authentication audit extract with userids hashed; includes timestamp, issuer, success/failure, and source IP blocks.
- SCIM mapping: I attached a small sample CSV (sample_scim_mapping.csv) that shows attribute mappings we usually share.
- RBAC matrix: attached is our canonical RBAC export (rbac_matrix_redwood_2026.pdf) covering built-in roles and escalation paths. That file contains role names and permissions; we redact internal-only product flags per policy.
- MFA policy: excerpt included in the runbook draft; escalation/exception process requires a signed JIRA ticket for each exception (security@redwood.com review).

We prefer to avoid sending raw production logs with full usernames — the hashed extract is standard and acceptable to most customers. If Bluewave requires de-anonymized records for audit, we'll need a signed NDA and an approved DPA addendum.

Next: Vanessa, I'll attach the one-pager runbook and a proposed timeline by EOD tomorrow. Rishi, any blockers on the log export?

Regards,
Marissa
Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_scim_mapping.csv, rbac_matrix_redwood_2026.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Jake Morris <j.morris@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG access controls: primary artifacts and quick runbook ask

Team / Jake,

Confirming technical feasibility and a small exception note from infra:

- SSO logs: I can generate the 30-day anonymized extract by Wed 2026-10-14 17:00 PT. The export will include: timestamp (UTC), subject_hash, issuer_id, result (success/fail), idp_response_code, source_cidr. Format: CSV.
- SCIM mapping: sample CSV attached earlier is representative; for a live SCIM test we need a shared test tenant and a short runbook to avoid unintended provisioning. Live test ETA: 7 business days from receipt of test tenant creds.
- RBAC matrix: the attached PDF is current. If Bluewave needs a role-to-resource example for a specific use case (e.g., support engineer limited access), say which resource and I can generate a scoped example.
- MFA: enforcement is on by default for employees; for service accounts we have a hardware-backed token requirement for privileged roles. Exceptions exist only via a documented JIRA workflow (see runbook link).

Privacy note for Bluewave: any unredacted user data requires a Data Transfer Agreement addendum and completion of our audit intake form (link below).

Deliverables and owners:
- One-pager runbook (Vanessa) — draft by EOD Tue 2026-10-06.
- SSO log export (Rishi) — Wed 2026-10-14.
- SCIM sample CSV + mapping notes (Marissa/Rishi) — Tue 2026-10-13.
- RBAC matrix (Marissa) — included now; scoped examples on request.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-SIG-evidence

If that timeline works for Bluewave, we'll proceed. Jake: please confirm whether you need any live provisioning tests or de-anonymized logs.

Thanks,
Rishi
Identity & Infra
Redwood Inference
